criteria.evidence: All sections present and substantive: What it does (4 bullets incl. term definitions), Inputs / Outputs ('In: the questions the ontology must answer (Q1 to Q7), the earlier version (v4)...'; 'Out: the ontology file at version 5, with per kind: what it is, who reads it, where it lives, a properties table, a relationships table, rules, states...'), Rules & behavior (7 rules), Acceptance criteria (6 Given/When/Then), Out of scope (4 items), Sources, Agent intent (ICE) with Goal/Limit/Fails if/Context/Checked by.

'Every kind a plan uses is defined under "Kinds", not left under "Not yet defined", because a play cannot write or check a kind the ontology has not defined, so a plan that names an undefined kind cannot be trusted.'; 'Rules say what holds once the product is aligned; they never stop a write, because the model grows as plans are built in any order and a blocked write would lose work already found.'; 'Tracker Issue also stays there, because the tracker is where work is ordered, not part of the product model'.

Discrete bullets throughout; acceptance in Given/When/Then: 'Given question Q7 ("what is its plan"), when a reader looks at its status, then it reads "answered" and names Plan, Capability, Functionality and Work.'; function stated as behavior, no user-story form.

Parent gives one line: 'Rebuild the product model as an ontology (fn-597) — the ontology defines every kind a plan uses, with its links, the ready rule and examples from more than one field.' The child adds the file location, the version 5 contents, what stays under 'Not yet defined' and why (Domain, Tracker Issue), the depends_on/needs naming rule, version/log rules, and six testable acceptance checks.

What: 'It is the one written agreement, at core/components/memory/standards/schemas/product-os/ontology.md, that a person and an agent both read to use the same words for the same things'. Why: 'a play cannot write or check a kind the ontology has not defined'. Edges: 'Changing the ready check script — A capability or functionality is ready without a domain (fn-724) owns that.'; 'Checking that links point at real nodes, and renaming depends_on to needs — fn-725 owns those.' Terms Q1-Q7, spine, needs and identified by are defined in the doc itself.
